description: This file defines a logging utility with a Logger type, ConsoleLogger class, and LogService for managing logging in a matrix extension environment. It includes functions for setting logging levels, resolving runtime loggers, and formatting messages, with external dependencies on node:util, openclaw/plugin-sdk/logging-core, openclaw/plugin-sdk/plugin-runtime, and a relative runtime.js.

classes.name: ConsoleLogger
classes.description: A class that provides methods to emit logs at various levels (debug, info, warn, error) either via runtime loggers or console.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: A no-operation function that does nothing.

methods.name: setMatrixConsoleLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables console logging based on the boolean parameter.
